note: The SWEPT PICK and the ladder it was measured on. tools/tune_baselines.nim --sweep replays a bounded matrix over this ladder and prints every candidate's margin; --check re-plays the ladder with the shipped constants and fails if the constants have drifted or the margin has left the band below. tests/test_procgen_control.nim asserts the same tunables through src/procgen/engine.nim's ladderTotals, which is the single implementation both use.
marginBandNote: The band is opened wide for the FIRST green CI run because the sandbox has no Nim and the ladder cannot be measured there. The run's own `--sweep` output is what pins it; the follow-up commit narrows marginMin/marginMax around the measured margin, which is what makes this file a regression pin rather than a decoration.
